column1: # This file is the system of record for "what is current." Not this conversation's
# memory, not the last thing said in chat — this file. The Governance Agent updates
# it every time a new version of any tracked document is produced; the placement
# script (place_governance_doc.sh) verifies against it before anything gets copied
# anywhere. If this file and a chat message disagree, this file wins — but only
# once you've confirmed IT is current (see AGENT_REFERENCE.md Conflict Resolution).
#   project_knowledge — Claude.ai project file management (not scriptable; manual replace)
# Lines starting with # are comments. Do not hand-edit the data lines below without
# also updating the checksum — if you change a file's content, you must regenerate
# its hash (shasum -a 256 <file>) or the verify script will (correctly) refuse it.
# REBUILT July 24, 2026. The prior version of this file was last updated July 18
# and had gone silently out of service: 10 entries, none from Sessions 54-61, and
# three of its five repo entries no longer matched the real files
# Briefing 133->122). Every governance placement since July 18 was therefore made
# by hand, bypassing the exact Rule 10 mitigation this file and its script exist
# to provide. Rows below are regenerated from the real files, not carried forward.
# TWO KNOWN SCRIPT LIMITATIONS, stated here rather than left to be rediscovered:
#  1. place_governance_doc.sh has no handler for docs/ — a `repo_docs` row will
#     fail loudly at its `*)` case. Place those by hand with an explicit checksum
#     check until script support is added (a small Build Agent fold-in).
#  2. The old AGENT_REFERENCE.md row used destination
#     `repo+icloud_root+project_knowledge`, which the script also rejects. That is
#     very likely part of why the tooling fell out of use. Its destination is now
#     `repo`; the iCloud-root and project-knowledge copies remain a manual step.
